results.benefit: Free LPG connection with first refill and stove (subsidy on subsequent refills)
results.explanation: PM Ujjwala Yojana provides free LPG connections to adult women from BPL households. As a 68-year-old widow with no regular income, you likely qualify under the BPL/SECC 2011 criteria. The scheme requires verification of BPL status and that no LPG connection exists in your household. Since you have no LPG connection, this is a strong match.
results.how_to_apply: Apply at nearest LPG distributor or online at pmuy.gov.in
results.source_quote: The Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY) was launched in 2016 to provide free LPG connections to women from Below Poverty Line (BPL) households.

results.benefit: Rs 5 lakh per family per year for secondary/tertiary hospitalization
results.explanation: PM-JAY provides health insurance of Rs 5 lakh per family per year. Eligibility is based on SECC 2011 deprivation criteria. As an elderly widow with very low income, you may qualify under the destitute/urban poor categories. Verification of SECC listing or income proof is needed.
results.how_to_apply: Check eligibility at beneficiary.nha.gov.in or via PMJAY kiosk at empaneled hospitals
results.source_quote: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY) is the world's largest government-funded health assurance scheme, launched in 2018.

results.benefit: Subsidy on home loan interest (CLSS): EWS/LIG up to Rs 2.67 lakh, MIG up to Rs 2.3 lakh
results.explanation: PMAY provides interest subsidy on home loans. As a widow with income below Rs 3 lakh (EWS category), you may qualify for EWS/LIG subsidy up to Rs 2.67 lakh. The scheme requires verification that you don't own a pucca house anywhere in India. Adult female ownership/co-ownership is mandatory for EWS/LIG.
results.how_to_apply: Urban: pmaymis.gov.in or via ULB/CSC; Gramin: pmayg.dord.gov.in or via Gram Panchayat
results.source_quote: The Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY) aims to provide 'Housing for All' through two components: PMAY-Urban (PMAY-U) and PMAY-Gramin (PMAY-G).

summary_text: आप 68 वर्ष की विधवा महिला हैं जिनकी कोई नियमित आय नहीं है। PM उज्ज्वला योजना के तहत मुफ्त LPG कनेक्शन, आयुष्मान भारत PM-JAY के तहत 5 लाख का स्वास्थ्य बीमा, और PM आवास योजना के तहत आवास सब्सिडी मिल सकती है। ये सभी योजनाएं BPL/SECC सूची में नाम होने पर लागू होती हैं। नजदीकी CSC या ऑनलाइन पोर्टल पर आवेदन करें।
disclaimer: Verify at official portal before applying.
